message:
We recently had a little scare when a storm rolled in faster than expected. As the winds picked up, we remembered the go-bags we had packed a few weeks ago—nothing fancy, just the essentials we put together as a family. That small effort made such a difference! We felt so much calmer knowing we were prepared, and it turned into a fun family moment as we gathered our supplies and shared a few laughs in the process. 🌧️ 

It’s funny how those little wins can really save the day! What’s a small prep step you’ve taken that made a big difference for you?
